cmd: LC_ALL=C grep -rnE '^[[:space:]]*\[.*\][[:space:]]*#.*\|\| *FAIL' --include='*.sh' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.venv . ; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 1 ] && exit 0; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo 'guard-swallow: || FAIL 被注释吞（防线假活）'; exit 1; fi; exit $rc

_t=$(mktemp) || exit 2; LC_ALL=C grep -rnE "docker exec .*(-e|--env)[= ]*['\"]?PGPASSWORD=" --include='*.sh' --include='*.py' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.venv . 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '^[^:]*:[0-9]*:[[:space:]]*(#|echo |printf )' > "$_t"; rc0=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; out=$(cat "$_t"); rm -f "$_t"; [ $rc0 -ge 2 ] && exit $rc0; [ $rc0 -eq 1 ] && exit 0; [ -n "${out}" ] && { echo 'cred-expose: PGPASSWORD 经 docker exec -e 暴露进程列表'; exit 1; }; exit 0
